title: fix(ui): avoid layout reads while extending capped drafts
body:
Supersedes #154272, thanks @alfredjbclaw.
Related: #154271

## What Problem This Solves

Typing at the end of a large, height-capped draft still forces repeated textarea layout in browsers using measured autosizing, even after #186874.

## User Impact

Appending text to an already capped draft keeps its height and scrolling without synchronous autosize or overflow measurements. Desktop and mobile growth limits stay the same.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse the draft that actually proved overflow in the existing sizing owner. Edits that replace or shorten that measured prefix, resize observations, and scheduled layout changes invalidate the result. Native content sizing keeps its existing path. No character-count guess is needed.

This replaces the old geometry-based maximum-height shortcut and duplicate observer lookups. Production delta is +33/-22 (net +11); the remaining growth records the proven draft and its invalidation lifecycle. The 107-line regression allocation covers measurement counts, shrinking, equal-length replacement, changed layout caps, and return to native sizing after a programmatic measurement.

## Evidence

- Red on main `0ad25113167c7c645429fa9db11b5cb3ad69a9ec`: both capped-input cases read `scrollHeight` four times instead of zero; replacement/layout case passed.
- Green after: all 66 tests pass in the named owner, Chat sizing, and New Session composer files. Vitest wall time 4.23s; wrapper wall time 5.17s. Owner regressions take 10ms total locally on Testbox, and 0.150s in hosted CI (4 passed cases). Crabbox/Testbox run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41594607265. (Baseline red proof: run 41593305601.)
- Touched-file format and lint checks passed (zero warnings/errors).
- Final committed-range autoreview (`0ad25113..5df9784e`) with the complete sizing owner and textarea caller as context: scoped clean at P0–P2. The earlier native-sizing finding is fixed and covered by the added regression. Review was static.
- [Final CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41595006650) completed all 60 primary jobs with no cancellations. All product, UI/browser, type, lint, and security checks passed; only the test-line budget guard and its aggregate failed: 6,421,808 lines against 6,421,800 (8 over), with this PR adding and funding exactly 107 lines. A detached Crabbox replay on main `0ad25113167c7c645429fa9db11b5cb3ad69a9ec` reproduced the same guard failure: 6,421,662 lines versus a 6,421,652 ceiling (10 over); the subsequent main commit removes 2 lines, accounting for CI’s 8-line debt. [Main replay](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41595128570). No baseline increase is included.
- Browser/Playwright proof was not run, per the host restrictions and requested focused-unit scope. This changes measurement work, not intended appearance. No latency benchmark claim; PR CI supplies broad proof.
- Contributor code was read through `gh` only and was never checked out or executed.

The automatic failure table compares an older scheduled main (`d921a2bf`, 06:32Z), which had 17 lines of slack. The later pinned-main replay above establishes the inherited failure independently. The shared baseline is unchanged; landing uses the native pre-existing-failure route.
